name: Complex of Koguryo Tombs
description: Around Pyongyang and Nampo in North Korea, about 30 tombs survive from the later years of Koguryo, a powerful kingdom that ruled much of the Korean peninsula and parts of Manchuria. Many hold vividly coloured wall paintings of daily life and mythology, made for kings, royals and aristocrats. Of the thousands of known Koguryo tombs, only about 90 have murals, and almost half are here.
